name: neuron-mercury
description: Nested cognitive neuron runtime for useful AI acceleration.

scripts.demo: node src/mercury.js run "analyze this repo for latency risk"
scripts.product:boost: node src/mercury.js product boost "diagnose this project for latency and paid provider risk" --path=.
scripts.ai3060:instant: node src/mercury.js ai-accelerator instant --model=auto --intent=ai3060.instant.demo --prompt="請用神經元和羅森橋說明如何讓本地 AI 回覆接近毫秒級"
scripts.ai3060:distill: node src/mercury.js ai-accelerator teacher-distill --model=auto --teacher-model=auto --intent=ai3060.teacher.demo --prompt="請用繁體中文說明大模型如何被 Mercury 蒸餾成毫秒級 replay"
scripts.ai3060:family-probe: node src/mercury.js ai-accelerator family-probe --model=auto --prompt="我的本地模型很慢但問題跟上次不一樣，先判斷該怎麼加速"
scripts.ai3060:domain-probe: node src/mercury.js ai-accelerator domain-probe --model=auto --prompt="我想知道地震和板塊運動的關係，先給我地球科學框架"
scripts.ai3060:lobster-probe: node src/mercury.js ai-accelerator domain-probe --model=qwen3:14b --teacher-model=qwen3:14b --keep-alive=2h --prompt="龍蝦背景診斷：找出延遲、資料庫膨脹、付費 provider 洩漏和錯誤 log 的優先修正順序"
scripts.bench:product: node src/mercury.js bench-product-activate && node src/mercury.js bench-night-runner-product-core && node src/mercury.js bench-diskspd-proof-artifact-guard && node src/mercury.js bench-speed-state-product-proof && node src/mercury.js bench-resident-product-proof-endpoint && node src/mercury.js bench-product-first-impression && node src/mercury.js bench-product-first-impression-trend && node src/mercury.js bench-product-proof-integrity && node src/mercury.js bench-product-proof-freshness-guard && node src/mercury.js bench-product-proof-refresh-plan && node src/mercury.js bench-product-3060-acceptance && node src/mercury.js bench-product-command && node src/mercury.js bench-product-boost && node src/mercury.js bench-windows-3060-product-proof
